title: How to make a character selection menu like in "Fear and Hunger"?

posts.author: Clarmo25
posts.body: Hi everyone! I played Fear and Hunger and the second part of this franchise, and I really liked the character selection menu, especially in the second part. How to do the same?

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: This thread was moved from RPG Maker MV Resources to RPG Maker MV Support.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Eventing a Picture-Based Menu | The Official RPG Maker Blog
The default RPG Maker menu works well, but sometimes you want one that fits your game’s aesthetic better or offers only the important options. Eventing your own picture-based menu is a great way to make sure your menu fits your game, so let’s take a look at how to make one.
www.rpgmakerweb.com

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Show a pic of the characters, pic of the text and pic of the frames. Put parallel event to register left/right keypress and move the frame pic and change the text pic when you press left/right.
